issues.problem: cn-nazenara rule said the reason must close with から, but its own examples and explain end というのは / だって reasons in んです / んだもん; applied mechanically the rule would mark those as wrong.
issues.action: Rule now reads 'close the reason with から or んです'.

issues.problem: cn-nazenara tip repeated the から-only ending.
issues.action: Tip now says 'ends in から or んです'.

issues.problem: cn-suruto example 窓を開けました。すると… was translated 'At once', which adds an immediacy that すると does not express.
issues.action: English changed to 'When I did, a cold wind came in.'

issues.problem: cn-tatoeba mistake pair ended 'たとえば、寿司や天ぷらです。', an awkward fragment for a model 'good' sentence.
issues.action: Bad and good now both end 寿司や天ぷらが好きです, so the only difference is つまり vs たとえば.
